metadata.title: Identifying Key Predictors of Resilience in Mathematics Engagement: Global Evidence From PISA 2022 Using Machine Learning

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value for mathematics achievement, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that final student weights were applied to account for the complex sampling design of PISA.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any methods that account for school clustering, indicating that it likely used student-level models without considering school-level effects.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed internal validation using five-fold cross-validation and a train/test split, which does not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.
